kurz: Salt loosens part of the protein structure in meat. As a result it holds on to more water as it cooks and stays juicier.
bild_im_kopf: Like a corset that is too tight being loosened a little: it still holds, but squeezes out less.
was_passiert: Dissolved salt slowly penetrates the meat and changes proteins in the muscle fibres. They contract less strongly when heated and bind more water. That takes time: after an hour the salt is only in the outer millimetres; after a day it is inside too.
warum_wichtig: Salted meat loses less juice when cooked and is seasoned all the way through, not just on the outside.
faustregeln: Salt early or right before, not 20 minutes before.
Thick cuts and poultry: salt overnight or up to two days ahead.

stellschrauben.wirkung: more → juicier, until it turns salty

praxis.text: Turkey and chicken benefit most, because breast meat is lean and dries out quickly.
Dry-salt pork chops and roasts overnight.
